details: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh indicated at the ECB Forum in Sintra that inflation risks have recently eased, though prices remain elevated. This statement has sparked speculation about potential future interest rate cuts, leading to a boost in risk assets, including cryptocurrencies. Bitcoin climbed above $60,000, and major altcoins like Ethereum and Solana also saw gains.
title: US Fed Chair Signals Easing Inflation Risks, Boosting Crypto

details: European Central Bank officials are signaling a more balanced outlook on inflation and growth risks. Factors such as declining oil prices, partly due to a US-Iran peace deal, and easing market-based inflation expectations suggest the ECB may adopt a less aggressive monetary tightening approach, potentially delaying further rate hikes beyond the recent June increase.
title: ECB Hints at More Dovish Stance Amid Declining Inflation Pressures

details: US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced persistent outflows throughout June, signaling a continued lack of strong institutional demand for Bitcoin. This trend has fostered a cautious sentiment among institutional investors and led some analysts, including Citigroup, to lower their one-year Bitcoin price targets.
title: Bitcoin ETFs Face Continued Outflows, Institutional Caution Lingers

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has challenged El Salvador's claims of continuous daily Bitcoin purchases. The IMF stated that no net new government Bitcoin acquisitions have occurred since early 2025, citing the terms of the country's $1.4 billion bailout agreement which prohibits voluntary public-sector Bitcoin purchases and mandates transparency.
title: IMF Disputes El Salvador's Daily Bitcoin Purchases Amid Bailout Terms
